strategy_vs_analysis.reason: The target SEG2 is chosen by comparing segment sizes and purchase intent (17.5M at 41% vs. SEG1 at 1.3M at 72%) against the 2% share and 1,500-point goals, as the document's figures support. Channels follow the market channel breakdown (68/17/9/6%), and the positioning follows the product facts. The pricing gap is acknowledged and explained by the missing competitor price data.

campaign_vs_strategy.reason: Every channel message (supermarkets, sport/organic shops, online, gyms/vending, Instagram) speaks to weekly sport practitioners and uses the 15 g protein and no palm oil/additives proposition, and uses only strategy channels. The minor gap is that the Instagram message is a generic lifestyle line and the content ideas mention Sea Salt and Rosemary while the Smoked Paprika flavour is not addressed. The organic-certified claim in the sport shop message is also not in the product brief, which lists vegan and gluten-free certification only.
